## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
- [Scoped] The diff adds a wholly new rule under `Necessary` — "Name a change in a line and leave its detail to the diff, which the reviewer can open; spelling out what an added rule, definition, or table row says is detail, whether quoted, summarized, or given with its consequence" — that has no precedent in the base version of `pr-guidelines.md` (confirmed against `git show b9256e45:claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md`, which has no equivalent clause anywhere in `Necessary`). The Purpose and Key Changes sections describe the `pr-guidelines.md` edit only as a structural reformat ("converting its rule bullets to a one-sentence top line … and lifting onto that line the requirements that sat behind a thesis sentence") plus five explicitly named rule changes (two new `Decidable` rules, the `Fix`/`Note` severity collapse, three bounded rules, the hard-wrap parser fix). None of the five named items covers this new constraint, so a reviewer relying on Key Changes would reach this hunk unwarned.

### Note
- [Scoped] The one-line change to `claude/skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md` (`"Must Fix" / "Should Fix"` → `"Fix" items, and the "Note" items worth acting on`) is a mechanical consequence of the severity rename described in Key Changes bullet 3, but it is not itself named, and the base `Scoped` rule in effect for this PR ("leaves no unexplained hunks") has no mechanical-consequence exemption — that exemption is one of the changes this very PR is introducing.
- [Scoped] Purpose frames the PR's intent narrowly around the `Decidable` altitude/hierarchy problem; the severity-tier collapse (`Fix`/`Note`) and the bounding of three unrelated rules (`Approaches rejected`, `Scoped` hunks, `Grounded` derivation) are explained individually in Key Changes but are not foreshadowed by Purpose, which states only the altitude problem as the reason for the change.
- [Grounded] The Verification section's derivation queries cite `main` as the tree-ish (`git ls-tree -r --name-only main …`, `git show main:…`) while the prose claims the counts hold "at the merge base." I independently reproduced the counts against the actual merge-base commit (`b9256e45`) and got matching results (pr-guidelines.md: 45 top-level bullets, 0 nested, the largest flat list among the 17 files; 37 rule bullets in the five property sections), so the claim is correct as authored — but a query keyed to `main` will silently diverge from "the merge base" once `main` moves past that commit, which is exactly what has since happened in this repository.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, cited as the record backing the exhaustive clause-mapping claim, is gitignored and not part of the PR diff. It exists on this machine and its structure and row count (103 table rows) are consistent with the claim, but a full clause-by-clause audit against the claim ("every clause landing at exactly one destination and none dropped or duplicated") is not something a reviewer working from a clone can check.

### Property walk
- Decidable: the body follows its own new altitude rule — every top-level bullet in Key Changes is the claim, with rationale and evidence nested beneath.
- Grounded: numeric claims (45 top-level bullets, 17 files, 37 carried-over rule bullets) check out against the actual merge-base commit; the `main`-vs-merge-base query imprecision is minor and noted above.
- Necessary: no diff-paraphrase or restatement found in the body itself, but the diff carries a new rule the body never names (see Fix above).
- Scoped: two hunks (one mechanical, one a broader-than-stated Purpose) are not explicitly accounted for; see Notes above.
- Conformant: no hard-wrap violations, checkbox usage is correct, title is one line, no auto-close keywords, no URLs in the body to verify.

### Verdict
NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT

cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
MB=$(git merge-base origin/fixture/367-base origin/fixture/367-head)
echo "merge-base: $MB"
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$MB" -- claude/rules claude/skills | grep '\.md$' | wc -l

cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
for f in claude/rules/execution-judgment.md claude/rules/external-tool-claims.md claude/rules/git-essentials.md claude/rules/implementation-delegation.md claude/rules/rule-authoring.md claude/rules/software-development.md claude/rules/subagent-model.md claude/rules/tech-doc-scoping.md claude/skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-reaction.md claude/skills/pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md claude/skills/retro-note/SKILL.md claude/skills/retro-review/SKILL.md claude/skills/retro-review/clusters.md claude/skills/retrospective/SKILL.md claude/skills/retrospective/analysis.md; do
  top=$(git show b9256e45:"$f" | grep -c '^- ')
  nested=$(git show b9256e45:"$f" | grep -c '^ \+- ')
  echo "$f top=$top nested=$nested"
done
git -C /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles show b9256e45:claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md | awk '/^## Decidable/,/^## PR Body Template/' | grep -c '^- '
git config --get core.excludesfile; echo ---; cat "$(git config --get core.excludesfile)" 2>/dev/null | grep -n ikuwowfiles
